question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hand**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the passage is about certain colleges having freedom in their operations.
 
• The expression should indicate having freedom or flexibility to make decisions.
 
• "**Hand**" fits well as it is commonly used in the expression "free hand," meaning the freedom to act at one's own discretion.
